notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA - Official Guidebook Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5992919/12daeddbe8735f5c7dac27d2390282d49ff9e7c6.png[/img]

Are you a fan of WORLD END ECONOMiCA but you want more? Then look no further, the WORLD END ECONOMiCA - Official Guidebook is available now on Steam! Please note that the guidebook contains spoilers so we highly recommend completing the trilogy BEFORE checking out the guidebook. And because this is a DLC you will need to own thee base game, WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.01, to purchase and download.

notes.title: WORLD END ECONOMiCA HD episode.01
notes.content:
Just released! 

The game now is playable in full HD, the art assets are now in 1440p! If you have a compatible display, you will be able take full advantage of the newly remastered art at double the original version's resolution. 

If you're using a 1080p or lower resolution display, don't worry. The game will still run at the original 720p or 1080p without losing any visual fidelity. 

This has been a free upgrade to all current and new customers.

If you want to finish the game on the older engine, please opt in to the renpy_old branch and you should be able to load from the older engine and finish the game there.

notes.title: New build out
notes.content: Just released a new build of WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.01. This unifies all platforms to a single engine called Ren'Py. This new build also includes a TLC/edited version of the script and incorporates feedback and fixes reported by customers.

notes.title: OSX/Linux alpha version released!
notes.content:
We just released the OSX and Linux versions of WORLD END ECONOMiCA episode.01. This is running on Ren'Py and has some bugs and missing features that we'll be adding/fixing.

[b]Known issues[/b]
[list]
[*] Preferences screen is a mess
[*] Sprites sometimes overlap each other
[*] Text sometimes messes with the interface
[*] Audio sfx sometimes does not play
[*] Music overlaps sometimes
[*] Movies don't play
[*] CG mode doesn't exist
[*] Music mode doesn't exist
[/list]

Please let us know if you run in to any crash bugs.
